<thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 235.1395, which corresponds to a protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 234.132 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass is C₁₄H₁₈O₃.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H18O3</final_answer>
